title: Combination Sum II
description:
Each number in candidates is a separate available item, even when two items have the same value. Find every distinct selection whose values sum to target. An item can appear in a selection at most once.

Return each selection in ascending numeric order, and return the list of selections in lexicographic order (compare numbers, with a shorter matching prefix first). Do not repeat identical selections. The empty selection is the sole answer when target is zero.

Example 1:

Input: candidates = [10,1,2,7,6,1,5], target = 8
Output: [[1,1,6],[1,2,5],[1,7],[2,6]]
Explanation: The two 1s are different items, but the selection [1,1,6] appears only once.

Example 2:

Input: candidates = [2,5,2,1,2], target = 5
Output: [[1,2,2],[5]]
Explanation: Repeated 2s can fill two slots without duplicating [1,2,2].

Example 3:

Input: candidates = [], target = 0
Output: [[]]
Explanation: Choosing nothing reaches a zero target.

Constraints:

  • 0 <= candidates.length <= 30
  • 1 <= candidates[i] <= 40
  • 0 <= target <= 40
